import requests

url = "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi"
params = {"db": "gene", "term": "O00411[Protein Accession]", "retmode": "json"}
r = requests.get(url, params=params)
data = r.json()
gene_ids = data['esearchresult']['idlist']
print("NCBI Gene IDs for O00411:", gene_ids)

if gene_ids:
    summary_url = "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi"
    r_sum = requests.get(summary_url, params={"db": "gene", "id": gene_ids[0], "retmode": "json"})
    doc = r_sum.json()['result'][gene_ids[0]]
    print("NCBI Gene Name:", doc.get('name'))
    print("NCBI Description:", doc.get('description'))
